title: Full-wave S-matrix and embedded element patterns of a 16 × 16 stacked-patch array
description: Full-wave scattering matrix (256 ports) and embedded element patterns of a 16 × 16 array of probe-fed stacked patches over an infinite ground plane, at the centre frequency and at the lower edge of a 6.3 % band. Frequencies are normalized to the centre frequency and lengths to the free-space wavelength. Computed with Palace 0.16.0. Includes MATLAB and Python code that reads and checks the data (MIT licence). See README.md for conventions and accuracy.
